Common mistakes on HomeKit / Matter zh-Hans listings

  • Translating only the description — name, subtitle, and keywords still English while Home-app screenshots dominate the gallery
  • Pasting 智能家居 into every keyword slot — crowding the 100-character field without room for your app’s actual category (lighting, security, HVAC, energy)
  • English room names burned into PNG exports — Connect caption fields are zh-Hans but Living Room and Bedroom labels on the image file are still Latin
  • Assuming HomeKit entitlement = listing done — entitlement approved and accessories pair in TestFlight but the zh-Hans App Store row was never saved
  • Confusing Matter certification with metadata — CSA Matter badge on hardware does not auto-fill Simplified Chinese on your App Store product page
  • Generic utility copy — description written for a general IoT app with one sentence mentioning HomeKit instead of naming rooms, scenes, and accessory workflows
  • Machine 翻译腔 on smart-home jargon — literal translations of “Works with Apple Home” or “Matter over Thread” that native readers do not use in App Store copy
  • Conflating with widget marketing — Home Screen widget gallery frames are a different surface; see widgets listing guide only if your product page leads with widgets, not Apple Home rooms

What good zh-Hans HomeKit / Matter listing copy looks like

Listing fields should name the smart-home surfaces you actually ship — aligned with your screenshot order:

  • Subtitle — one concrete promise: “HomeKit 与 Matter 智能家居控制” or “一键管理全屋灯光与场景” — not vague “智能生活”
  • Keywords — mix category terms (灯光, 安防, 温控) with platform intent (HomeKit, Matter, 智能家居) within Connect’s ~100-character zh-Hans budget; see Simplified Chinese keywords guide
  • Description — short paragraphs for room control, scenes, automations, Matter pairing, and camera or sensor workflows — mirror screenshot sequence
  • Screenshot captions on Home-app frames — name the on-screen action: “在 Apple 家庭 App 中管理所有房间” not “强大功能”
  • Sample room and accessory names in caption lines — when your gallery shows example data, caption sheet lists zh-Hans equivalents (客厅, 卧室灯) for designer re-export
  • Matter badge phrasing — plain-language zh-Hans for compatibility callouts without untranslated English badge text on marketing frames
  • Voice consistency — same 你/您 choice as your description across overlay lines and promotional text

Connect checklist for HomeKit / Matter apps targeting China

  1. Open App Store → Chinese (Simplified) — confirm the zh-Hans row exists; empty rows fall back to English on the China storefront
  2. Audit searchable fields — name, subtitle, keywords, description saved in zh-Hans, not placeholder English
  3. Walk the screenshot gallery in order — flag frames showing Apple Home room grids, accessory detail sheets, automation editors, Matter onboarding, or Works with Apple Home badges
  4. Export overlay lines — spreadsheet of English caption text per frame beats screenshots of Connect alone
  5. Note burned-in vs Connect captions — if room names or accessory labels are embedded in PNGs, caption deliverables go to your designer for re-export
  6. Separate entitlement from metadata — HomeKit or Matter entitlement approval is not a substitute for filling zh-Hans listing fields; AppLocale does not manage entitlement requests
  7. Verify China in Pricing and Availability — storefront enabled before expecting zh-Hans to appear
